quotations.old_english: Ðá héht hé ðone drý infeccan beforan hine
quotations.english: he ordered the sorcerer to be fetched into his presence

source_text: in-feccan to fetch in :-- Ðá héht hé ðone drý infeccan beforan hine he ordered the sorcerer to be fetched into his presence, Blickl. Homl. 175, 1.
